输入子项菜单默认触发关键字`@`后可进行目标角色的选中和提及。.en-us: Type the default trigger keyword `@` to select and mention a target.

设置参数`placement`控制子项菜单展开方向。.en-us: Use `placement` to set the submenu direction.

设置参数`status`强制状态渲染。.en-us: Use `status` to force a status style.

设置参数`prefix`自定义触发选择菜单展开的关键字。.en-us: Use `prefix` to customize the keyword that opens the selection menu.

通过回调函数监听已输入内容、已提及目标项。.en-us: Monitor entered text and mentioned items through callbacks.
